why: A same-file callee reads a reference parameter's cell through the constructors of the parameter's shape, so a call is in the heap core only when every cell its argument may hold is one of them (heap.mjs argShapeWhy; design/heap-stage5.md 17c). who passes a Person to greet(p: Named): the Person cell is another constructor, and the core read the name there as the prelude's default "", proving who equal to `return ""` (it was proved before the rule). Now the call keeps who out of the core, and greet and hi with it (one calling convention per callee): the value reading does not prove who (WITNESS); hi and greet are proved there. circ passes a Circle to size(s: Shape), a union whose alternatives' constructors include Circle's: the rule keeps circ and size in the core (HEAP: circ,size, as at base). circ is proved there: a field declared as one literal is its primitive holding that value (heap.mjs shapeOf, as a union of literals is), so circ's hypothesis states what Circle says, IsR_<Circle>(hw_, c) && kind == "c", and size takes its Circle branch (not proved at base, where the hypothesis did not state the discriminant: lane/union-discriminant-hypothesis-result.md).
